title: Exclude shared P104 banks funded by two paid subdivisions
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The exact comparator is #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

The replay reconstructs the exact common-span bank search funded by two already paid rank-two public MOVEs. All 17 normalized support forms fail exterior prefix rank. It regenerates the original 16 exclusions and tests the remaining bank on roles 572 and 1255 at all nine raw keys. Its rational minor on axes [0, 890] has determinant −1/2 and reduces independently to 32768 at 65537. No form remains unresolved in this scope.

The signed 17-copy invoice charges P1 +68 and P2 −34, plus T4 +17, T5 +17 and T9 −17. Paid positions would be 110,553 and productive positions 22,478. The one-edit optimistic margin is at most 0.209047826097918 raw at the old crossing. No supported construction reaches the price gate.

## Task and overlap

This is the charged two-mover extension of `p104-side-correction`. #7362 and #7364 establish singleton stock and occupancy. #7117 and #5751 give earlier construction precedents for two subdivisions. The [original bounded screen](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19555656) covered 16 forms and left the tested residual. The research commit adds only `research/p104-two-paid-subdivision-bank-bound/`. The existing #7257 commits address the canonical CI navigation mismatch documented in #7371.

## Validation

Run from a clean checkout with CPython 3.12.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-two-paid-subdivision-bank-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates #7362 and #7334 inputs, regenerates all eight receipts and rejects two changed dependency controls. Registered-package, source-history, navigation and export checks passed. Exact signed physical construction was unnecessary after the prefix obstruction.

## Credit and open next questions

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact word and signed caller. #7338 and #7298 supply the invoice and directed tariff. #7362 and #7364 supply anchor geometry and retimed occupancy. #7148, #7117 and #5751 supply subdivision precedents. #7355 and #7339 supply support methods. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

Unequal spans, extra bank occupants and changed scalar chronology lie outside the common-span, fixed-contact scope. Any extension should price its whole invoice before support search. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
